sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Combat Proven is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Look what my guys made! The rigs look like a perfect match, but they still need to be tested. If you can beat the local hotshots with them, then it's a good product."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Locate and neutralize any 5 Bosses (excluding The Goons, The Wedge and Partisan) while using any Goons Edition tactical rig

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +92,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.03
- 340,000 Roubles
  - 357,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 391,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× NPP KlASS Bagariy plate carrier (EMR)
- Unlocks Laminate Hideout floor style
"So, how was it? No stiffness, no tearing? Then maybe I can increase the price a bit... Oh, right, here's your reward, you're a life saver!"
